known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Identity confirmation: only explicit confirmations count; ask at most twice (answering a customer question first), then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Security-question refusal: explain once; a second refusal or second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Track three wrong answers total across both questions; swapped-hint retries and unreadable values do not count; after three, refer to mobile app or branch and close not_verified/failed. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Numbers-only dates of birth are read day, month, year before conversion to YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Weekend/holiday date not after deadline: offer next business day; after deadline: offer deadline, refusal of deadline counts as flat refusal. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Per product: count persuasion attempts (1 early, 2 late); floor offered once after 'too much'; below-floor offer once; never repeat a refused offer; exhausted -> note refused (B) and move on. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Vague period: ask once for the exact day, then propose the deadline. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A confirmation is bound to the exact read-back; a change of date or amount requires re-check and a new read-back. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On restructuring request, agreed but unrecorded promises must not be written; recorded ones stay; no add_note before or after any transfer. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist (before or after verification). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): Customer says twice they do not want to talk: before verification close not_verified/declined, after verification note refused on remaining products and close no_promise/refused. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage closing): Final close reason without a recorded promise: all notes paid -> paid; else no_promise with the reason of the first non-paid note in get_account order. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

unresolved conflict: Hardship (A rule 32) with several products: chose 'whole call: no further persuasion; offer support transfer; if declined, note each unpromised, not-yet-noted product as hardship and close per B closing rule; customer-named dates/amounts still recorded' (Rule 32 forbids persuasion attempts once hardship is mentioned and the life event concerns the customer, not a product; B gives no per-product hardship rule beyond the note reason.)

unresolved conflict: Refusal to talk twice (A rule 45) or attempts exhausted with remaining products: chose 'rule 45: note refused for every remaining unpromised product and close per B closing; rule 31 exhaustion on one product: note refused for that product and continue with the next' (B rule 5 makes attempts per product; rule 45 concerns the whole conversation.)

unresolved conflict: Promise followed by human/support transfer in Brief B: chose "transferred with that transfer's reason, no notes" (Brief A: 'If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as `transferred` with that transfer's reason.' and B rule 10 forbids notes on any transfer; B's 'promise wins' exception names only rule 10 but A's transfer rule is not replaced.)

code: deadline per band (Nth business day after now, calendar from the policy)
promise date validity (past / after deadline / non-business day)
vague period: ask 1 time(s), then the deadline
amount: full first, floor offer after 'too much' or a below-floor amount, accept floor..full
shared date clamped to each product's deadline
read-back of the whole package, confirmation bound to that package, writes only from the confirmed package
hardship: one code-owned sympathy+support offer, no persuasion afterwards, customer's own date/amount kept
notes per product (used), none after a transfer; close outcome from recorded/transfer/product results
goodbye -> notes -> exactly one close_call in the negotiation path
model: turning the customer's words into events and dates into YYYY-MM-DD (calendar table given)
identity question order, re-asks, declines (bank result routes to the account step)
opening confirmation and its re-ask count
third party, callback window validity and re-ask
transfer decision and queue (close mapping is code)
questions outside payment (robot/scam answers come from the policy)
